provenance.source: The table in issue #80 of MINT-SJTU/RoboScope-Kit, reported on 2026-11-05.
notes: Transcribed by hand from the issue, not produced by the record command, because the run's output directory is not available. Only numbers the issue states are here.
Rates are rounded to 0.1 steps/s and GPU utilization to whole percents, as in the issue.
replica_vram_bytes is the issue's approximate '~11 GiB', and vram_per_gpu_bytes its '48 GiB', not exact byte counts.
The issue gives 818 s for the whole search only, so no probe has a wall time.
cpu_cores is the issue's '208 CPU cores'. Whether that was the cgroup quota the search saw is not stated.
All rows are diagonal probes (steady estimator, three work items per Worker). two-phase with its default elapsed estimator runs a different, fixed-size probe, which this record does not cover.
bound_hint is absent; the controller's default, gpu_infer, is what the RoboCasa adapter of commit d26a908 reports.
date is unknown: the issue states when the run was reported, not when it ran.

unmeasured: Every point with g > 1, and every K above 16. K=16/g=1 finished without a steady window and the issue gives no rates for it. The fixed-K/g sweep announced in issue #80 had not landed when this record was written.
